subject: Afterglow: request to revive lapsed pilot and credits
messages:
From: Amit Shah <amit@fiberscale.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Afterglow: request to revive lapsed pilot + credits

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for the support during our pilot. We hit a snag: our procurement cycle and internal security review pushed our timeline out, and the sandbox credits expired last week before we could complete a final round of latency and throughput tests.

Quick ask: would Redwood consider a 30-day revival of the pilot and a modest top-up of credits so we can finish the evaluation? We estimate ~$4k–$6k in token usage to finish the last two benchmarks and a production-proof smoke test. If you can consider a one-time safety-net grant, we can commit to sending a PO for production within 30 days.

I've attached a short usage summary and a draft PO for procurement to review.

Attachments:
- Fiberscale_trial_usage_summary.pdf (summary of runs / token consumption)
- Fiberscale_PO_draft.pdf (procurement draft)

What we really need from Redwood:
- 30-day sandbox reactivation window
- $5k in trial credits OR a staged credit plan tied to PO submission

Happy to hop on a 20-minute call if helpful — otherwise any guidance on next steps would be great.

Best,
Amit Shah
Head of ML Platforms
Fiberscale.ai
From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>

Hi Amit — thanks for the clear context and for sending the usage summary.

Short answer: we can usually support a one-time reinstatement for pilots in this situation, but I need to coordinate conditional approval with Sales Ops / Finance. I @'d Marissa and Ben to speed this.

Couple quick clarifying items that will help approvals:
- Can you confirm the PO timeline (you mentioned within 30 days; will procurement commit to a PO within 14 days of credit grant?)
- Which SSO / org id did you use for the pilot (so we can reattach previous KV/prefix caches if applicable)?
- What are the two final evaluation metrics you need to validate (latency P95 target, cost-per-request target, throughput target, etc.)?

I'm proposing the following approach for efficiency:
1) We consider a 30-day sandbox reactivation window.
2) A one-time credit top-up staged against PO submission: initial $2.5k immediate, remainder released when PO is committed within X days.

Marissa / Ben — could you confirm if $2.5k as an interim top-up is doable and what documentation you need to record this as a one-off? If Finance is comfortable, Jordan will confirm back to Amit and apply the credits.

Thanks — Jordan

Jordan / Amit — looping in formally from CS / AM side. Reviewed the usage summary and the draft PO. Appreciated the detail.

We can approve a conditional credit top-up:
- Immediate grant: $2,500 applied to the Fiberscale sandbox account
- Condition: Fiberscale submits an approved PO for production licensing within 14 calendar days of the credit grant (procurement@fiberscale.ai on copy of that PO)
